district: Paso Robles Joint Unified School District
summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue $205 million in bonds for school facilities, repaid by a property tax of about $50 per $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: A yes vote supports authorizing $205 million in bonds funded through local property tax levies to renovate and upgrade school facilities.
tax.quote: A “yes” vote on this measure is a vote in favor of the issuance of $205 million in general obligation bonds to be used for the purposes set forth in Measure G-26.

schools.text: A yes vote approves dedicated bond financing to construct, renovate, and modernize classrooms and facilities across the school district.
schools.quote: The bond measure will fund improvements to the District’s classrooms and facilities for the benefit of the District’s students in grades 9 through 12

tax.text: The No side opposes Measure G-26's proposed $205 million bond, which would be repaid through an assessed-value property tax.
tax.quote: Opponents who filed a written ballot argument against the measure
